posts.author: Ohhanyways
posts.body:
So, I'm horrible making maps and since i want to be a india dev, i would rather not ask/pay someone else to make maps for me.
I was thinking since AI is a big thing nowadays that i could ask ChatGPT to make a (plugin) script for me that would create a described environment (in this case, a forest), but when GPT made the script and i put it in the plugin command option on a event, i got a "SyntaxError" "Invalid or unexpected token" message.
I've multiple other AI and have gotten the same error, different errors, or straight up nothing happens
So does anyone know if it's possible to use script to automatically make a map for you? I am using RPG Maker MZ

posts.author: Zia_
posts.body:
What you are trying to do is far beyond the processing capacity of ChatGPT and way too complex to just put together 100 lines of code and be good to go.
Aerosys made a random map generator plugin.
[RPGMaker MV & MZ] Random Maps by Aerosys
Plugin to randomly generate Maps during Playtime! (RPGMaker MV & MZ)
aerosys.itch.io

Learn to code and learn to do level design.  Shortcuts will get you nowhere.
Also Chat GPT is an idiot, so don't rely on it to code anything.
AI is not a do all for everything and only churns out junk when you don't understand what you're doing.
AI coding is like a supplement real coders can bounce ideas off and use to help them with problem solving (and even then its not super efficient).

posts.author: Arcaines
posts.body:
Long story short no. Well, you can have random Map generator plugins but these won't have the same feel of someone hand drawing the map.
One thing a machine can't do is have the imagination to design something.
Even AI generated content can't make something from it's own thought and uses other human designs.
If you really want to Game dev then either pay someone to do it for you or learn.
